domain: Physics culling and Rigidbody sleep coordination

defectsFound.fact: Runtime, impact, and Shinobu37 clear paths incremented contention after failed write-lock acquisition but still continued into Vault-backed clear loops.
SetPhysicsCullingTuning and GenerateMockPhysicsBodies wrote Vault-backed lanes without scoped write-lock transactions.

changes: ClearRuntimeState skips root Vault clear loops unless the runtime clear lock set is acquired.
ClearPhysicsImpactEventQueue1337 returns immediately on impact-lane write-lock failure.
ClearShinobu37PhysicsCullingState skips Vault clear loops unless the Shinobu37 clear lock set is acquired.
SetPhysicsCullingTuning writes under _physicsCullingTuning.TryAcquireWriteLock and releases in finally.
GenerateMockPhysicsBodies completes/discards active culling jobs, acquires DTO/frozen velocity/state age/state snapshot locks as a single transaction, and returns 0 on lock failure.

buildGate.policy: Do not run dotnet build while CPU > 50% or csc/dotnet is active.
